name: math-rush
description: Fast, arcade-style mental-math trainer that runs as a static site. Pick a mode, solve against the clock, earn XP, and climb a knowledge map from addition to derivatives.

scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply math-rush-platform --local --config worker/wrangler.local.toml --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.test: node tests/progress.cjs && node tests/derivatives.cjs && node tests/quiz-settings.cjs && node tests/site-smoke.cjs && node tests/program-exams.cjs && node tests/runner-play.cjs && node --test tests/cloud-progress.test.cjs tests/platform-api.test.mjs tests/legacy-account.test.cjs tests/multiplication-learning.test.cjs
